title: Kylo Ren & General Hux Confer
description: A tense competitiveness exists between Kylo Ren and General Hux, as both vie for the attention and approval of the First Order's mysterious commander, Supreme Leader Snoke. A man of science and technology, Hux has little understanding of, or patience for, the mystical side of the First Order that Kylo Ren represents. His father was a highly placed official in the Imperial Academy of old - and Hux feels it is a matter of destiny that he be given a chance to sit on the throne that rules the galaxy. To Hux, the future of warfare is now — a war that can, and will, be won with a single shot.
